title: Add hover-to-remove control for selected color/photo/theme backgrounds
description:
In the Background settings panel, the custom/uploaded photo slot already shows a hover "✕" remove control on the currently selected thumbnail (see attached screenshot — top-left dark swatch with the ✕ overlay) that clears the selection back to default.

Extend this same hover-to-remove interaction to:
1. Photos grid — the other thumbnails (stock/preset photos, and the topo theme default). Whichever one is currently selected should show the same hover "✕" affordance to deselect/revert to default, same as the custom photo already does.
2. Colors & Gradients grid — same hover-to-remove behavior on the currently selected color/gradient swatch, reverting to default on click.

Additionally: remove/replace the dedicated "no background" (diagonal-striped) swatch in Colors & Gradients — it's redundant once hover-to-remove exists on the selected swatch itself, since that's now the way to get back to "no background"/default. Confirm with whoever owns the color list what "default" should resolve to when removed (likely the same default/theme background as elsewhere in this settings panel).

Since removing the "no background" swatch frees up a grid slot, add one more real color/gradient option in its place (pick something that fits the existing set stylistically — e.g. another solid or gradient consistent with the current palette). Check with the user/Designer if a specific color is wanted; otherwise choose a sensible complementary addition.

Relevant file: components/SettingsPanel.js (Background settings — Colors & Gradients and Photos grid rendering, near where the custom photo hover-remove is implemented) — mirror the change into meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js as with prior background-related changes.

Note: this touches the same settings panel area as the in-progress task switch-app-background-to-topo-light-topo-dark-sy-0283 (fixing the transparency/blur slider regression). Coordinate/rebase against that fix rather than working in parallel to avoid merge conflicts.
label: Feature

activity.content: Implemented hover-to-remove controls for selected color, gradient, stock-photo, and topo presets. Removing a preset restores the theme-aware topo default. Replaced the diagonal No background swatch with a complementary Garnet solid, added the topo default to the balanced 12-slot photo grid, and mirrored all component/CSS changes into meridian-extension. Added focused regression coverage. Validation: syntax checks passed, git diff whitespace check passed, source/package parity passed, and all 137 Node tests passed.
